description: Create a read-only or read/write workspace or app key. The secret is returned once.

app_id.description: App UUID to clamp the key to one app. Omit or pass null for a workspace key. An app-scoped caller can only create keys for its own app.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

label.description: A name for the key, 1 to 80 characters, shown by list_api_keys.

scopes.description: ["read"] or ["read", "write"]; every key needs read, so the API refuses ["write"] alone. Read permits every read, including the POST attribution lookup; write is also required to create, update, rotate, archive and revoke, and to record server events and decisions.

name: create_api_key
title: Create a management key
